queries.name: ubg0_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name, DB_NAME() AS database_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name, USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: ubg0_candidate_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND (o.name LIKE '%Rail%' OR o.name LIKE '%Clearing%' OR o.name LIKE '%SPEI%' OR o.name LIKE '%ACH%' OR o.name LIKE '%SEPA%' OR o.name LIKE '%Fedwire%' OR o.name LIKE '%Bank%' OR o.name LIKE '%Banco%' OR o.name LIKE '%HostToHost%' OR o.name LIKE '%Host_To_Host%' OR o.name LIKE '%SFTP%' OR o.name LIKE '%SWIFT%' OR o.name LIKE '%File%' OR o.name LIKE '%Archivo%' OR o.name LIKE '%Execution%' OR o.name LIKE '%Ejecucion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Event%' OR o.name LIKE '%Evento%') ORDER BY s.name,o.name

queries.name: ubg0_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, c.name AS column_name, t.name AS data_type FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=c.object_id INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.type IN ('U','V') AND (c.name LIKE '%IBAN%' OR c.name LIKE '%ABA%' OR c.name LIKE '%SWIFT%' OR c.name LIKE '%BIC%' OR c.name LIKE '%UETR%' OR c.name LIKE '%Routing%' OR c.name LIKE '%Rail%' OR c.name LIKE '%Clearing%' OR c.name LIKE '%SPEI%' OR c.name LIKE '%ACH%' OR c.name LIKE '%SEPA%' OR c.name LIKE '%Fedwire%' OR c.name LIKE '%HostToHost%' OR c.name LIKE '%SFTP%' OR c.name LIKE '%BankFile%' OR c.name LIKE '%ArchivoBanco%' OR c.name LIKE '%ExternalExecution%' OR c.name LIKE '%ExternalEvent%') ORDER BY s.name,o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: ubg0_sql_modules_references
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.sql_modules m INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=m.object_id INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE m.definition LIKE '%IBAN%' OR m.definition LIKE '%SWIFT%' OR m.definition LIKE '%UETR%' OR m.definition LIKE '%SPEI%' OR m.definition LIKE '%ACH%' OR m.definition LIKE '%SEPA%' OR m.definition LIKE '%Fedwire%' OR m.definition LIKE '%HostToHost%' OR m.definition LIKE '%SFTP%' OR m.definition LIKE '%PaymentRail%' OR m.definition LIKE '%BankFile%' OR m.definition LIKE '%ExternalExecution%' OR m.definition LIKE '%ExternalEvent%' ORDER BY s.name,o.name

queries.name: ubg0_finanzas_pagos_related_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_Pagos') AND (c.name LIKE '%Banco%' OR c.name LIKE '%Cuenta%' OR c.name LIKE '%Referencia%' OR c.name LIKE '%FormaPago%' OR c.name LIKE '%Rail%' OR c.name LIKE '%Canal%' OR c.name LIKE '%SWIFT%' OR c.name LIKE '%IBAN%' OR c.name LIKE '%UETR%') ORDER BY c.column_id
